title: Hawkeye Halloween Meatballs
description: Want to make something really special with your kids this Halloween? Roll up some eyeball meatballs that are tasty and fun to eat. Served with your family's favorite pasta, they'll make an easy dinner that your kids will be talking about for weeks. And if your kids aren't excited about green olives, then swap with black olives for a spooky look. So invite the kids into the kitchen and start rolling your way to this ghoulish dish!
ingredients: Maybe some finely chopped onion, or some onion and garlic powder, with Italian spices
Dash of pepper and/or some hot sauce
6 to 8 large green or black olives
directions: Mix the meat, egg, breadcrumbs, ketchup, mustard, onions, spices, and mayonnaise until the mixture comes together.
To create the eyeballs, cut the center out of a cheese ball. Then cut an olive in half and position into the center of the cheese, creating a spooky eye.
Roll golf-ball-size meatballs and then press an indentation in the middle of the ball. Place the cheese eyeball into the meatball and press and mold the meat around the cheese eye.
Place them in a foil-lined baking pan and bake the meatballs for 20 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the meat is cooked through.
While the ghoulish meatballs are baking, prepare your favorite pasta and sauce so everything is ready when your meatballs are.
Remove the finished meatballs, and serve over cooked pasta.
